latest.headline: SubaruNyx Commands Portugal with Six Stage Wins
latest.paragraph: SubaruNyx delivered a masterclass in Portugal, securing a dominant victory by winning six of the eight stages. Despite finishing fourth in the final stage, the overall performance was unmatched, resulting in a total time of 01:03:34.693 and 37 points. Cefa217 claimed second place and the Power Stage win, while scagliox01 rounded out the podium. This win marks the second victory of the season for SubaruNyx following their success in Mexico. The event saw five drivers record DNFs, highlighting the challenging nature of the Portuguese stages for the field.
